_doc: Svelte closed world: routes/+page.svelte is an entry (SvelteKit entry_re); $lib/... imports resolve by path suffix; on:click={inc} and {fmt(count)} are uses of the script functions; Stale.svelte and unusedHandler are dead. A directive names a function of the script: use:tip, transition:fly|local, in:slideIn, animate:flip keep tip, fly, slideIn and flip alive; neverUsedAction is dead.
